MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card fits my repeated need for removable storage, provided my device supports its 256GB capacity and microSDXC format.",
    "A Fire TV Stick offers a useful way to add streaming to my older television, though my 720p screen would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Photography tripods and lens accessories do not mean I want a doorbell or home monitoring camera; those serve different needs.",
    "The smart displays, speaker, earbuds, and keyboard do not address an upgrade or accessory need I currently have.",
    "The SSD enclosure requires a spare compatible drive, and my memory card purchases give no reason to assume I own one."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in a broader range of Alexa and smart home devices.",
    "My purchases of camera and storage accessories seem to have been extended to products with similar names but different uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories that support equipment I already use, including cards, cables, mounts, and power strips.",
    "Compatibility matters: memory card format and capacity, connector type, and my television's resolution determine whether an accessory is useful.",
    "The two Fire TV Sticks meet the same need for me; I would choose one, and the themed cover adds no particular appeal."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and television needs but stretched my accessory purchases into unsupported interest in smart home devices and unrelated upgrades."
}
